name: ls
summary: Lists the contents of a directory.
description: Shows the files and subdirectories of the current directory, or of the given paths. By default, hidden files (whose name starts with a dot) are not shown and entries are sorted alphabetically.

options.description: Long format: type and permissions, number of links, owner, group, size, modification date and name.
Also shows hidden files, including “.” (current directory) and “..” (parent directory).
With -l, shows sizes in readable units (K, M, G) instead of bytes.
Sorts by modification date, newest first.
Also lists the contents of subdirectories, recursively.
Shows the directory itself rather than its contents.
Shows the inode number of each file.
Adds a type indicator to the end of names: / for a directory, * for an executable, @ for a symbolic link.
Colors the output by file type.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File or directory to list. Default: the current directory.

examples.explanation: Detailed list of the current directory.
examples.output:
-rw-rw-r-- 1 esprit esprit   47 Jul 12 21:14 file1
drwxr-xr-x 2 esprit esprit 4096 Jul 12 21:10 projects

examples.explanation: Everything in the home directory, hidden files included, in long format.
Files in /var/log sorted from largest to smallest, readable sizes.
The five most recently modified files (the first line is the total).
